name: Suzuki GT750
engine: 738 cc liquid-cooled two-stroke triple, three carbs, oil injection
intro: The Water Buffalo. A liquid-cooled two-stroke triple whose crank seals and water pump decide everything.

add.title: Leak-down test the crankcase
add.instructions: Seal the ports and pressure test the crankcase. Leaking seals mean the bottom end has to come apart.
add.reason: Old crank seals are the classic GT750 fault and let it run lean.

add.title: Check the water pump gear and seals
add.instructions: Inspect the nylon water pump drive gear for worn or broken teeth, and the pump seals for leaks.
add.reason: A failed water pump cooks the engine.

H: Check the exhaust flange threads in the head. Stripped threads are common on early-70s Suzukis.

recallNote: Any recalls on bikes this old were closed long ago.

known.title: Crank seals
known.what: Hardened crank seals are common and need a full bottom-end rebuild.
